name: Asana
description: Organize your work and boost your team's productivity with Asana. This easy-to-use app helps you manage tasks, projects, and deadlines all in one place.

Retrieve Asana workspaces; choose fields to return, enable pretty output, or set a limit.
Retrieve a project's details and choose which fields to return.
Retrieve tasks from a selected project with optional filters and page-by-page results.

Deletes a project using its project ID.

Fires for each new tag created in the selected Asana workspace, checking tags created since the last poll (oldest first, up to 100 per page). Each item has gid, name, color, created_at and workspace.

Polls one project and returns each task that has an assignee and changed since the last check, newest first; later edits to an assigned task fire again.
